intent: Apply the approved Index / Simplified visual contract while preserving link and privacy behavior.

template_scope.presentation_ownership: This template owns its spacing, typography, background, density, and interaction choices.
template_scope.candidate_rule: Different visual directions should become separate templates instead of mutations of this template.
template_scope.shared_content_rule: Shared content stays in src/data/site.json and should remain useful across templates.

accessibility_controls.focus: a:focus-visible and button focus states must remain visible
accessibility_controls.headings: one h1 followed by section h2 labels
accessibility_controls.contrast: text and icon colors must remain readable against surfaces

activation_requirements: src/data/site.json remains the shared content source
route labels and URLs are unchanged unless the content contract changes
privacy and analytics behavior are unchanged
mobile and desktop screenshots are reviewed
